question: Does selective incremental no-gradient programming of persistent factor weights retain previously learned interaction structure and learn added real genotype consequences at lower total cost than cumulative full retraining, without loss of unseen-site-pair transfer?
reason_for_pivot: WSP-194 direct unseen-pair coverage failure, WSP-196 HD4 conventional-control failure and WSP-198 direct spectral held-RMSE 0.6912816 vs converged rank4 ALS 0.4643859. Those frozen negative results are not re-scored or retuned.
hypothesis: Against the same-rank converged cumulative factor refit, selective direct writes achieve >=2.0x lower summed end-to-end training/update time across four cumulative FIT stages; <=2% higher independently held DEV site-pair-equal-weighted RMSE; <=5% worse B0 witness error after three later learning stages; exact cold restoration. Also separately report whether higher-capacity rank8 full refit wins.

source.source_rights: Underlying measurement/derivative rights not independently resolved. No source bytes, model weights or outputs redistributed. Source-specific clearance required before consuming numeric outcomes.

eligibility.pre_label_only: Parse source columns aa_genotype_pseudo, aa_genotype_native, gene; require known wt and both exactly matching native-background parent single-genotype rows; strict two unique standard-AA site substitutions; no duplicates. Fail closed on unknown reference, nonstandard/stop codes, missing parents or source hash drift. Exclude by genotype structure ONLY.
eligibility.outcome: Use measured replicates_mean_brightness as a finite numeric value for both WT/singles/doubles; no brightness-based row exclusion. Invalid/missing numeric values or changed admitted source stop the study; no opportunistic censoring.
eligibility.target: For each eligible double in background b, y=asinh(brightness_double)-asinh(brightness_single1)-asinh(brightness_single2)+asinh(brightness_wildtype). Read WT/single brightness as common predeclared auxiliary evidence to all methods; all held DOUBLE brightness fields remain unread until their own scored gate.
eligibility.background_scope: Analyze each background separately using the same algorithm/protocol. Three backgrounds from one publication are correlated, NOT three independent physical worlds.

split.unit: whole (gene,min(mutated_position_i,mutated_position_j),max(...)) site-pair group across all alternate amino acids
split.digest: SHA256(UTF8('WSP200-GFP-PAIR-v1\u0000'+gene+'\u0000'+decimal_min_position+'\u0000'+decimal_max_position)), first 8 digest bytes big endian unsigned modulo 100
split.stream: For FIT-only site-pair groups define second SHA256 of UTF8('WSP200-FIT-STREAM-v1\u0000'+gene+'\u0000'+min_position+'\u0000'+max_position), first 8 bytes modulo 4; reveal B0,B1,B2,B3 in index order. At each stage all arms see the identical cumulative FIT observations only.
split.no_leakage: Never move/merge groups to satisfy thresholds, never use held groups in fitting/scaling, never use PUBLIC_DEV or RESERVED labels to choose algorithm, rank, gate, lambda, seeds, budget or model revisions.
split.scaling: For each background compute mean and population SD of interaction target using only B0; fail if SD<=1e-12. Use (y-mean)/SD at all stages and arms without re-estimation.

representation.type: Native non-token persistent factor weights; one address per (gene,mutation_site,source_aa,destination_aa) single-mutant identity; each observed double uses exactly two addresses; no genotype text embeddings or pretrained donor.
representation.function: predicted normalized interaction = dot(h_address1,h_address2); rank4 per-address float64 factors. Sign/order of factors have no semantic interpretation; predictions, not raw factors, measure cold retention.
representation.init: Each factor coordinate initialized to +0.01 or -0.01 from SHA256('WSP200-INIT-v1\u0000'+address+'\u0000'+coordinate) low bit; no future data used.
representation.loss: sum over observed cumulative FIT doubles of (yhat-y)^2 + lambda*sum over active addresses ||h||², lambda=10, rank=4; factor count and optimizer work tracked.

candidate.name: bounded contradiction-gated direct ridge weight writes
candidate.initialization: On B0 run exactly 16 deterministic full-address block-coordinate normal-equation passes, ascending address order; each address solves (X'X+10I) h = X'y with Cholesky; add deterministic 1e-9 diagonal jitter only on decomposition failure; failure after jitter invalidates candidate.
candidate.staged_update: For B1..B3, predict newly witnessed batch from previous persistent weights BEFORE any write. For each address with at least 2 distinct new double-mutant observations, compute signed residuals (observed minus predicted). A contradiction candidate requires >=75% of nonzero residuals share a sign and abs(mean signed residual)>=1.0 B0-normalized units.
candidate.gate_budget: Order eligible addresses by descending abs(mean signed residual) then ascending UTF8 address; update at most ceil(0.25*number_of_newly_observed_addresses). Unflagged address factors are unchanged. Two deterministic ascending-address closed-form ridge solve sweeps using all cumulative FIT pairs incident on flagged addresses; never SGD/gradient backprop.
candidate.persist: Write every factor coordinate, source digest, consumed FIT-group identities, stage number, and deterministic stream cursor to versioned checkpoint; exact byte-preserving serialize/deserialize and idempotent duplicate-evidence rejection.

controls.same_capacity_full_refit: rank4, lambda10, identical addresses/observations/feature map, deterministic block-coordinate ridge solves to relative objective improvement <=1e-6 for 3 successive full sweeps or max 100; if not converged => comparator INVALID, not candidate win. Warm-start from previous cumulative stage, plus independent cold-start diagnostic.
controls.higher_capacity: rank8, lambda10 fully converged same procedure; log 2x factor parameters, independent stronger-capacity comparator, not an equal-capacity victory.
controls.always_update: same rank4, same 2-sweep new-batch local solver but all newly observed addresses, not capped
controls.surprise_gate: same write count as contradiction gate, selected by descending mean(abs(new residual)) with same eligibility/count and address tie-break, rank4
controls.random_gate: same write count as contradiction gate, choose by SHA256('WSP200-RANDOM-v1\u0000'+stage+'\u0000'+address) ascending, rank4
controls.no_update: initial B0 programmed factors frozen throughout B1..B3
controls.shuffled_negative: FIT double interaction target shuffled within background and stream stage by fixed seed 20031, preserving addresses/groups; no held label use.
controls.readout_only: B0 additive/no-interaction zero residual predictor; reference negative.

metrics.primary_error: At B3 compute each held PUBLIC_DEV site-pair's mean squared normalized interaction error then average groups equally within background and backgrounds equally; square-root for reported RMSE. Rank4 cumulative full refit is primary matched comparator.
metrics.cost: Measure B0 initial programming plus B1..B3 updates, serialization/cold restore, data admission, selection, reads and source verification separately and combined; wall-clock monotonic and CPU-ms, peak resident memory, number of normal-equation solves, changed weight addresses and stored bytes. Claim speed only on full comparable end-to-end cost.
metrics.retention: After B0, fix each B0 witnessed pair's prediction and squared error; score the same B0 pairs after B1,B2,B3 WITHOUT training replay from scratch. Compare final error ratio candidate vs matched full refit; distinguish retained bytes from retained prediction quality.
metrics.transfer: Completely unseen PUBLIC_DEV whole-site-pair groups; report per-background and per site-pair-frequency stratum. Do not call this new protein/world transfer.
metrics.cold: After each stage, serialize, restart a fresh process, restore exact state, verify hash/checkpoint version/consumed evidence; identical predictions for every B0 and fixed source-free sentinel, idempotent repeated receipt causes zero state changes.
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 stratified-by-background bootstrap resamples of PUBLIC_DEV whole site-pair groups, seed 20041, paired across methods; report 95% percentile CI for relative RMSE gain and full cost ratio. Never resample individual rows as independent.
metrics.gate: SUPPORT only if source/fit/control valid, candidate all four stages, exact cold restore, no duplicated evidence, candidate vs rank4 full-refit end-to-end cumulative training/update cost ratio >=2.0, candidate held-RMSE <=1.02*rank4 RMSE, candidate B0-retention MSE <=1.05*rank4 B0-retention MSE. Record comparisons vs rank8 separately. Development support not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
metrics.stop: If a fully qualified original public DEV comparison misses any precommitted gate, record PUBLIC_DEV_NO_GO, do not tune against it. If source invalid, control unconverged, leakage, nonfinite values, or execution failure, record INVALID, not NO_GO; fix source-free faults before any future qualified first-use, not by replaying consumed labels.

validation_and_authority.source_free_before_any_outcome: Implement tests with independently fabricated tiny genotype/source-free samples, exact partition/unit tests, duplicate/missing-parent/stop/altered digest negatives, normal-solver independent reference, idempotent cold restore and no future-label leakage.
validation_and_authority.qualification: Require exact candidate SHA/tree, both Windows/Linux full final regression and separate source-index qualification before optional owner-authorized original first use. Engineering PASS does not license original labels.
validation_and_authority.first_use: Not authorized under this contribution. Do not read numeric fluorescence targets, run original-data fitting/scoring, consume RESERVED cohort, dispatch a runner, touch protected Yggdrasil issue #426, or claim any data science until separate verified source-specific authority and licensing clearance.
validation_and_authority.independent_qualification: The new three-background source is one independent published dataset, not independent replication; publish provenance and strict nulls, then seek another genuinely independent world for scientific support.
